result.summary: This PR adds LIFETIMEBOUND annotations to several accessor methods in httpserver.h (HTTPHeaders::FindAll, HTTPRequest::GetVersion, HTTPRemoteClient::GetOrigin/GetPeer, GetRequest, GetRecvBuffer) so that Clang's lifetime analysis can catch dangling-reference bugs at compile time. It is a follow-up in the same spirit as #36164, which added similar diagnostics to string utilities. The change is purely annotation-based with no functional or performance impact.
result.problem: Methods returning references or views into internal state (like HTTPHeaders::FindAll returning string_views) can be misused to create dangling references after the owning object is destroyed or mutated, a subtle footgun for developers working on the HTTP server code. This PR helps the compiler catch such misuse early, benefiting maintainers of the HTTP server code.
